full_page.content:
1924, May
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1
Page 10 Cont.
May 20 Non Catholic Seeks Blessing in S. M Assoc. Louise Ahrendt, non catholic heartsore about only daughter 25. Latter has not been with widowed mother for five years, comes to see her very seldom -- disapointed herself, seems unappreciative. Mother joins both for a year in S.M. Assoc. and before leaving monastery decides to take regular course of instruction. June 23 started regular in- struction.
28 Mrs. Margaret Clifford 342 - E. 93rd (58) before going to hospital To-day for probable serious tumer operation Enrolls her- self perpetually in S.M. Assoc. Was under operation June 15 - Left Hospital July 9th and July 26th has Mass of Special thanksgiving - everything O.K.
29 Jeremiah Brennan (60, foreman in Marston Lumber Co - E. 125 St) drinking heavily
30 Alice Rhead 18 (1723 Jarvis Ave.) Swolen neck, pink eye, non Cath- olic - thinking of marrying Catholic
31 Antoinette Bittel 5 of 1863 DeCalb Ave Brooklyn, physically strong but never spoke -- hearing doubtful, doctors baffled and hopeless, parents of course anxious. June 8 seems improved a little, tries to speak - can hear evidently.
31 "This is a Miracle." Thomas Buckley drinking, abusing wife beyond endurance. She decides to brake up house. Court decides it best to do so. "Wait, says a neighbor, "till I put your Husband in S.M. A. Maybe he would change." A week later the poor wife could hardly be- lieve the result. "It is like a dream" She acknowledges to her good neighbor (Miss Dolan) Thomas has become like a youthful lover." Thanks be to God!
Page 11 June 3 Anthony Artale (48) 75 Wilber Ave S.L. City, Away from wife and family three years - not to confession for 17 years - since married. Sad to say when a boy and a youth had been frustrated in earnest efforts to be a priest. Even after marriage remained devoted to B. Mary Virgin. Enrolled to-day as beginning for perpetual 50¢ pd.
